research_objective: Minimize worst-case predicted distribution-network electrical stress while satisfying hard grid, mobility, storage, AI-service, and recovery constraints.
common_formulation_rule: B00-B09 use one H54 formulation and objective; only capability, replan-policy, and risk-interface masks may differ according to the frozen registry.
planning_resolution: All grid, SOC, dispatch, workload, recovery, and stress quantities are evaluated on 54 physical five-minute steps. Mobility departure decisions use the common R26 multiresolution grid: five-minute starts through 60 minutes and fifteen-minute starts thereafter.
rolling_mobility_trust_region: Each H54 solve may schedule at most one new relocation per MESS. A subsequent relocation can be scheduled by the next causal event replan from the newly committed state; all destination, allowed departure-stage, and frozen K3 route choices remain available for the planned relocation.
solver_quality_contract: Each lexicographic priority pass requires a certified relative MIP gap no larger than 3%. Hard physical and service constraints retain their original tolerances and are not softened. A 300-second engineering ceiling fails closed unless the solver has reached the tertiary pass and its certified gap target.
soft_mobility_screening_contract: Workload-based or score-based mobility screening is disabled by default and has no production hard-fixing authority. It may be enabled only for paired technical diagnostics through PFR_EXPERIMENTAL_LEGACY_CAUSAL_SCREENING=1; until a predeclared multi-state oracle gate passes, the heuristic may serve only as MIP-start and branching guidance.

stress_components.voltage_planning: limit-normalized LinDistFlow squared-voltage epigraph; 0 at 1 pu and 1 at 0.95/1.05 pu

planning_to_evaluation_semantics: The causal planner minimizes a radial-network surrogate normalized to the physical limit endpoints, may report predicted stress above one, and never treats the surrogate epigraph cap as execution authority; the paper-facing realized KPI and hard H0 commit decision are recomputed from Fresh three-phase OpenDSS voltage magnitudes and current/kVA loadings.
hard_constraints: Fresh exact H0 voltage remains within 0.95 and 1.05 pu
Fresh exact H0 line loading <= 1 pu
Fresh exact H0 transformer loading <= 1 pu
MESS route, connection, SOC, PCS P-Q circle
GPU gang, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, deadline
terminal workload debt and support-energy debt recovery
excluded_from_optimization_objective: electricity price or ex-post grid cost
